title: Career Roadmap · Mobile Repair Technician
summary: A Mobile Repair Technician diagnoses, repairs and tests smartphones and tablets, including hardware faults, charging issues, displays, batteries, connectors and supported software problems.

blocks.label: Recommended
blocks.text: Class 10 with Science and Mathematics for relevant ITI routes.

blocks.label: Stream
blocks.text: Science is useful, but not mandatory for every private training or repair-service pathway.

blocks.label: Explore
blocks.text: Electronics, circuit boards, connectors, batteries, displays and device diagnostics.

blocks.label: Early skills
blocks.text: Fine-motor control, safe tool handling, systematic troubleshooting and customer communication.

rows.text: ITI Mechanic Consumer Electronics Appliances, where available
Advanced electronics, embedded systems and engineering roles

blocks.text: A dedicated mobile-phone repair qualification may be offered by different training providers; it is not automatically equivalent to a DGT-recognized ITI trade. Check the current official course and awarding-body details before enrolling.

blocks.label: Stage 1 — Foundation
blocks.text: Electronics basics, ESD safety, tool handling and device anatomy.

blocks.label: Stage 2 — Core skills
blocks.text: Display and battery replacement, charging-port diagnosis, connectors and safe disassembly.

blocks.label: Stage 3 — Advanced skills
blocks.text: Board-level diagnostics, microsoldering, schematic reading and supported software troubleshooting.

blocks.label: Stage 4 — Career preparation
blocks.text: Repair portfolio, service records, customer communication and supervised practice.

blocks.label: Project ideas
blocks.text: Diagnose a faulty charging circuit • Practise connector replacement on scrap boards • Build a repair checklist • Create a device-testing and quality-control log.

blocks.text: Electronics workshops, vocational institutes and eligible public-sector maintenance units.

blocks.label: Private
blocks.text: Authorized service centres, mobile repair businesses, electronics refurbishment companies and device distributors.

blocks.text: Hardware diagnostics • Board-level repair • Quality testing • Warranty and customer service.

items.text: Advanced mobile-device diagnostics and microsoldering training.
Embedded systems or electronics testing courses for broader technical opportunities.

blocks.label: Specializations
blocks.text: PCB repair • Charging and power faults • Microsoldering • Smartphone diagnostics • Refurbishment and quality testing.

blocks.label: Industries
blocks.text: Smartphone service, consumer electronics, device refurbishment, telecom retail, authorized service networks and independent repair businesses.

blocks.label: Technical skills
blocks.text: Fault diagnosis, soldering, safe battery handling, circuit reading, connector repair, ESD protection and device testing.

blocks.label: Tools / technologies
blocks.text: Digital multimeter, soldering station, hot-air rework station, microscope, DC power supply and approved diagnostic software.
Useful credentials

items.text: Practical microsoldering or board-repair training from a reputable provider.

blocks.text: No single certification guarantees authorization to repair every brand or device.

blocks.label: Countries to explore
blocks.text: Germany, Canada, Australia, UK and Singapore.
Institutions / routes to investigate

items.text: BCIT — Canada; electronics engineering technology options.
TAFE NSW — Australia; electronics-related vocational programs.
German vocational training — electronics and device-service-related occupations.
UK further-education colleges — electronics engineering technician courses.
Singapore Polytechnic — electronics-related programs; verify international admissions.

blocks.label: Common requirements
blocks.text: Academic records, language proficiency where applicable, program-specific prerequisites and proof of funds or other requirements where relevant. Dedicated smartphone-repair programs may be offered by private providers rather than universities.

blocks.label: Roles
blocks.text: Mobile Device Repair Technician, Electronics Repair Technician, Refurbishment Technician and Device Testing Technician.

blocks.label: Industries
blocks.text: Consumer electronics, refurbishment, retail service, telecom and electronics repair.

items: Local credential / language checks where required
